messages:
marta (oncall): FYI we've got elevated latency and partial 503s on the embeddings and text-gen endpoints for eu-west since ~10:02 UTC. Opened INC-2026-04-15-42. Need customer comms cadence and statuspage copy.
ana (Marcom): Thanks — do we have scope yet? which customers affected (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?
marta (oncall): Mostly hosted API in eu-west. Dedicated pools unaffected so far, private customers unaffected. Rough estimate: 30-40% of requests failed or retried.
james (Support): Getting inbound from 3 enterprise accounts, they're seeing higher tail latency. Can we surface impact level clearly for them?
ana (Marcom): Proposed approach: immediate brief statuspage entry (investigating), a short public tweet-ish line, and an emailed note to enterprise contacts if the incident passes 30m. Agree?
lee (Product): +1. Also recommend adding quick mitigations customers can try (fallback region, smaller batch sizes). We can put that in the Support FAQ.
marta (oncall): Oncall timeline: mitigation experiments rolling for next 15m, will hit canary rollback if not improved by 25m.
ana (Marcom): Draft statuspage copy v1 (short): "We’re investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for the Redwood hosted API in eu-west. Our engineers are actively diagnosing and rolling mitigations. We’ll post updates every 30 minutes." Thoughts?
james (Support): Clear. For enterprise email I'd add: "No data loss; private and dedicated deployments unaffected." That calms customers.
ana (Marcom): Good call. Draft enterprise email subject options: [1] "Redwood: Investigating eu-west latency" or [2] "Service disruption affecting hosted API in eu-west — update" Which is less alarmist?
marta (oncall): I prefer #1 for first brief. If we confirm broad impact, escalate to #2.
ana (Marcom): Noted. Also need to coordinate timing: publish statuspage now (short) and hold enterprise email for 30m unless situation degrades. Approve?
james (Support): Approve. Support team will triage inbound and use a canned snippet linking to statuspage + recommended mitigations. Can you share the snippet?
ana (Marcom): Snippet for Support (2 lines): "We're investigating higher latency and intermittent errors in eu-west. See live updates: <statuspage_link>. Recommended: retry with exponential backoff or route to another region." Use :thumbsup: if OK.
lee (Product): Add note to snippet: "No action needed for Dedicated/Private customers."
ana (Marcom): Updated. translations-bot: please prep FR/DE/ES translations for the statuspage copy and enterprise email templates.
translations-bot: queued for FR/DE/ES, ETA 20m.
marta (oncall): Quick internal timeline: statuspage posted at 10:10 UTC (investigating); checkback 10:30 UTC with update. If mitigation successful, post "identified and mitigating" + recovery ETA; if not, escalate to broader customer email.
james (Support): I'll prepare the enterprise email list (accounts with active incidents) and draft the tone — leaning empathetic + pragmatic.
ana (Marcom): Draft statuspage final (publish now): "Investigating — We are seeing increased latency and intermittent errors on the Redwood hosted API in eu-west. Customers using dedicated or private deployments are not affected. Our engineers are working on mitigation; we will post updates every 30 minutes."
ana (Marcom): publish ✅ (posted at 10:10 UTC).
marta (oncall): Thanks — will post next update at 10:30 UTC. If we decide to send enterprise email, I'll flag here with recommended language.
james (Support): Received. I'll use the Support snippet and monitor replies; will escalate urgent ones to this thread.
ana (Marcom): After-action note: once resolved, we should send a follow-up that contains root cause + mitigation + customer guidance (config/best-practices) and update docs. Keep this thread for timeline notes.
marta (oncall): Update 10:30 UTC: 10% error rate remaining, latency improved after canary rollback. Continuing to monitor. Recommend wait for 1 full recovery window before sending enterprise email.
ana (Marcom): Copy that — holding the email. I'll prep the post-incident message and a short FAQ for Support while we monitor.
james (Support): Thanks — will patch canned replies with the FAQ when available.
translations-bot: FR/DE/ES statuspage translations ready (10:42 UTC)
marta (oncall): 10:45 UTC: incident moved to "monitoring", errors back to baseline. I'll close INC once stable for 30m.
ana (Marcom): Great — draft post-incident public copy: "Resolved — We experienced increased latency and intermittent errors in eu-west impacting hosted API. A rollback to a previous routing layer mitigated the issue. No customer data was lost; dedicated and private deployments were not affected. We’ve published mitigation steps and recommendations for routing and retry best-practices." Any edits?
lee (Product): Add a line linking to technical notes and how customers can pin regions + fallback guidance.
ana (Marcom): Will add. Plan: publish post-incident at T+45m, send enterprise email T+60m with tailored notes. Approved?
james (Support): Approved.
marta (oncall): Closing thread for now, will update when INC is formally closed. Thanks everyone.
